buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then npx convex deploy -y && npm run build; else npx convex deploy -y --check-build-environment disable && npm run build; fi
ignoreCommand: if [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" ] || [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "develop" ] || [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "main" ]; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi
